data.name: Veilborne Sacrament
data.detailed_description:
VEILBORNE SACRAMENT

A psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and mystery.

After receiving a disturbing lead connected to a long forgotten disappearance, you return to the isolated Morwain Estate. What begins as an investigation soon becomes a descent into something far older and far more sinister than expected.

Explore a sprawling mansion filled with hidden passages, cryptic clues, disturbing discoveries, and dark secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Can you uncover the truth behind the Morwain family before it consumes you as well?

FEATURES

• Immersive psychological horror experience

• Explore a detailed mansion filled with secrets and hidden areas

• Descend into a terrifying underground complex where a relentless entity stalks your every move

• Solve intricate puzzles redesigned and rebalanced in the Reawakening Update

• Discover notes, documents, and environmental storytelling that reveal the dark history of the Morwain family

• Atmospheric visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5

REAWAKENING UPDATE

• Completely overhauled lighting and visual presentation

• Fully completed German localization

• Redesigned puzzles with improved clarity and additional hints

• New tutorials and improved player guidance

• Enhanced stalker AI behavior

• New scares and hidden events

• Additional secrets and easter eggs

• Improved performance and stability

• Numerous bug fixes and quality of life improvements

The Veiled Trial remains unsolved.

Will you be the first to uncover its final secret?

The Veiled Trial

Hidden deep within the Morwain house lies a truth that goes beyond the main story.

The Veiled Trial is an optional in-game challenge designed for players who enjoy uncovering secrets through careful observation, logic, and persistence.
It is not required to complete the game and does not affect the main ending.

All puzzles can be solved using information found naturally within the game world.
No brute force, no guessing, and no external guides are necessary.

Once the challenge becomes fully solvable, players will receive an in-game notification.

The first player to successfully complete The Veiled Trial will receive a €50 reward.
To ensure fairness, a full, unedited video recording of the solution process must be submitted for verification.

Further details are available in-game.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains disturbing imagery, psychological horror themes, and mild depictions of blood and death.
Some scenes include lifeless bodies and unsettling environments.
No sexual or explicit content is present.
